alkimiya-2025.label: the original attacker
alkimiya-2025.note: Yoink pre-empted the account that had spent nearly an hour preparing and testing this exploit.

bifi-2026.label: probably the original attacker
bifi-2026.note: A bot took the funds after this account deployed its setup, but its intended finishing transaction and originality remain unproved.

blueberry-2024.label: probably the original attacker
blueberry-2024.note: The bot beat a public, prepared exploit attempt; the losing account is a likely attacker, with original authorship unresolved.

curve-vyper-2023/pETH.label: probably the original attacker
curve-vyper-2023/pETH.note: A bot beat the likely source pETH attempt, followed by other exploit copiers.

curve-vyper-2023/msETH.label: a later exploiter or unknown
curve-vyper-2023/msETH.note: The bot beat a known pETH copier adapting the exploit to msETH; whether that copier was another bot is unknown.

curve-vyper-2023/CRV-ETH-wave2.label: a later exploiter or unknown
curve-vyper-2023/CRV-ETH-wave2.note: The bot beat the same known adapter during a later CRV/ETH wave, with another follow-on participant nearby.

defiplaza-2024.label: a later exploiter or unknown
defiplaza-2024.note: Yoink beat a prepared exploiter, but another address exposed exactly the same deployment earlier, leaving the original source unresolved.

dodo-v2-2021.label: the original attacker
dodo-v2-2021.note: Antelope beat the postmortem’s initiating attacker after that attacker staged the pool.

earningfarm-2022.label: probably the original attacker
earningfarm-2022.note: The bot beat a prepared exploit attempt by an account that later retried successfully; originality remains likely.

kelp-rseth-2026.label: the original attacker
kelp-rseth-2026.note: Yoink pre-empted the attack’s own preparer, with a second searcher attempt in the same block.

makina-2026.label: the original attacker
makina-2026.note: The protocol identifies the original attack deployment that the winning searcher pre-empted; no attacker finishing call landed.

neemo-2025.label: the original attacker
neemo-2025.note: A bot used the setup installed through the compromised administrator account before any finishing call by that account was observed.

punk-2021.label: the original attacker
punk-2021.note: The victim’s report and the attacker’s own setup identify the original attack the whitehat bot beat.

shoco-2023.label: probably the original attacker
shoco-2023.note: An anonymous bot beat a prepared exploiter, but the saved record does not prove that exploiter originated the plan.

transitswap-2022.label: the original attacker
transitswap-2022.note: Yoink beat the established campaign attacker’s ninth Ethereum attempt after eight earlier attacks had succeeded.

uncx-2026/yoink-X.label: the original attacker
uncx-2026/yoink-X.note: Yoink beat the account that initiated this Ethereum exploit campaign, while other bots or copiers appeared much later on another token.

unizen-2024/pending-ads.label: a later exploiter or unknown
unizen-2024/pending-ads.note: Yoink beat a later sender whose recipient links to the first theft, but the sender’s ownership and role remain unresolved.

unizen-2024/pending-usdt.label: a later exploiter or unknown
unizen-2024/pending-usdt.note: Yoink beat an exploiter using almost the same deployment as the earlier thief; it could have been a copier bot or a related account.

unizen-2024/pending-xi.label: a later exploiter or unknown
unizen-2024/pending-xi.note: Yoink beat a known follow-on exploiter to the remaining XI; whether it intercepted a pending attempt or copied the landed first half is unresolved.
